title.sl: Oba, nobeden: both, neither, each, all
title.de: Beide, keiner: both, neither, each, all
title.it: Entrambi, nessuno: both, neither, each, all

rule.sl:
Za **dva**: **both** (oba), **neither** (nobeden od njiju), **either** (kateri koli od njiju): **Both dogs are asleep.** **Neither of them is here.** **Either of them will do.** Za be, pred drugim glagolom: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** Ljudje rečejo tudi *the both of them*; pisno je **both of them**.

Po **neither** je glagol pozitiven. Z not je **either**: **I don't like either of them.** Ljudje rečejo tudi *I don't like neither of them*; pisno je **either**. V govoru tudi **Neither of them are here.**

Pari: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** Ljudje rečejo tudi *neither Jack or Sam*; pisno je **nor**.

Za več: **every** (vsi skupaj), **each** (vsak posebej, tudi za dva), z ednino: **Every sheep has a mark.** **Each of them has its own mark.** **every one of them** (nikoli *every of them*).

**all** in **none**: **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** **None of them is**, **None of them are**: prav je. Ljudje rečejo tudi *I haven't got none*; pisno je **any**.

Pred zaimkom vedno **of**: **all of us**, **most of them**, **one of them**, **some of them**.
rule.de:
Für **zwei**: **both** (beide), **neither** (keiner von beiden), **either** (einer von beiden): **Both dogs are asleep.** **Neither of them is here.** **Either of them will do.** Nach be, vor anderen Verben: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** Man sagt auch *the both of them*; geschrieben steht **both of them**.

Nach **neither** ist das Verb bejaht. Mit not steht **either**: **I don't like either of them.** Man sagt auch *I don't like neither of them*; geschrieben steht **either**. Gesprochen auch **Neither of them are here.**

Paare: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** Man sagt auch *neither Jack or Sam*; geschrieben steht **nor**.

Für mehr: **every** (alle zusammen), **each** (jeder einzeln, auch für zwei), in der Einzahl: **Every sheep has a mark.** **Each of them has its own mark.** **every one of them** (nie *every of them*).

**all** und **none**: **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** **None of them is**, **None of them are**: das stimmt. Man sagt auch *I haven't got none*; geschrieben steht **any**.

Vor einem Pronomen immer **of**: **all of us**, **most of them**, **one of them**.
rule.it:
Per **due**: **both** (tutti e due), **neither** (nessuno dei due), **either** (l'uno o l'altro): **Both dogs are asleep.** **Neither of them is here.** **Either of them will do.** Dopo be, prima di altri verbi: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** Si dice anche *the both of them*; per iscritto si usa **both of them**.

Dopo **neither** il verbo è positivo. Con not si usa **either**: **I don't like either of them.** Si dice anche *I don't like neither of them*; per iscritto si usa **either**. A voce anche **Neither of them are here.**

Coppie: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** Si dice anche *neither Jack or Sam*; per iscritto si usa **nor**.

Per di più: **every** (tutti insieme), **each** (uno per uno, anche per due), col singolare: **Every sheep has a mark.** **Each of them has its own mark.** **every one of them** (mai *every of them*).

**all** e **none**: **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** **None of them is**, **None of them are**: va bene. Si dice anche *I haven't got none*; per iscritto si usa **any**.

Davanti a un pronome sempre **of**: **all of us**, **most of them**, **one of them**.
rule.en:
For **two**: **both**, **neither** (not one and not the other), **either** (one or the other): **Both dogs are asleep.** **Neither of them is here.** **Either of them will do.** After be, before other verbs: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** People also say *the both of them*; writing wants **both of them**.

After **neither** the verb says yes. With not it's **either**: **I don't like either of them.** People also say *I don't like neither of them*; writing wants **either**. In talk also **Neither of them are here.**

Pairs: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** People also say *neither Jack or Sam*; writing wants **nor**.

For more: **every** (all together), **each** (one by one, for two too), with the singular: **Every sheep has a mark.** **Each of them has its own mark.** **every one of them** (never *every of them*).

**all** and **none**: **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** **None of them is**, **None of them are**: that's right. People also say *I haven't got none*; writing wants **any**.

Before a pronoun always **of**: **all of us**, **most of them**, **one of them**, **some of them**.

tip.sl: 💡 *Ne Jack ne Sam ne prideta* ima tri ne, **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** ima enega.
tip.de: 💡 *weder … noch* = **neither … nor**; das Verb bleibt bejaht.
tip.it: 💡 *Né Jack né Sam vengono*: in inglese il verbo resta positivo: **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.**
tip.en: 💡 **neither** already says no: **Neither of them is here.**
